items.detail: User, ipc, pid, uts and net namespaces unshared, no nested user namespace, /usr /bin /lib /lib64 read-only, private /proc /dev /tmp, cleared environment, dies with its parent.
items.label: Substrate's namespace and mount set under bubblewrap

items.detail: --net keeps the host network namespace and changes nothing else in the list.
items.label: No network unless asked

items.detail: Observed under bwrap: a sibling of the working directory cannot be read, and a --ro root can be read but not written.
items.label: Undeclared host paths are absent

items.detail: Refuses to run when dev.tty.legacy_tiocsti is 1, unless --allow-tiocsti; it stands in for bwrap --new-session.
items.label: Terminal-injection guard

items.detail: The common ancestor becomes /workspace; each directory is bound at its relative path, so ../lib resolves as on the host.
items.label: Mirrored /workspace with --dir

items.detail: Relative, non-canonical, missing, duplicated and nested inputs are each a named error.
items.label: Input paths refused, never adjusted

items.detail: --backend docker: the same layout through docker run as the caller's uid, no capabilities, no network, read-only image root.
items.label: Docker backend

items.detail: No bwrap or no docker exits 2 with the program's name; nothing runs unconfined or on the other backend.
items.label: A missing backend is a refusal, never a fallback

items.detail: Layout::plan, Confinement::new, argv, command and run: the same computation the command line uses.
items.label: b10x_sandbox Rust library

source: sandbox-docs, from its capability list; every shipped item names the test that holds it
